reviews.shade: [SET] 04 Nudy Cocoa (+Lip Pencil Mini No.25 Beige Ring Lip Lighter)
reviews.text: The color is not too thick, and it really fits my skintone and daily make up. Iuse it every day ever since i bought it!!!
reviews.zh: 顏色唔會太厚重，而且真係好夾我嘅膚色同日常妝容。自從買咗之後我日日都用！！！

reviews.shade: [SET] 04 Nudy Cocoa (+Lip Pencil Mini No.25 Beige Ring Lip Lighter)
reviews.text: Not for me, but I can see why others would like this. The color and color payoff are beautiful, but the formulation isn't to my taste. It's a bit to oily for me.
reviews.zh: 唔啱我，但我明白點解其他人會鍾意。顏色同顯色度都好靚，不過配方就唔係我杯茶。對我嚟講有少少太油。

reviews.shade: [SET] 03 Peach Filter (+Lip Pencil Mini No.23 Peach Ring Lip Lighter)
reviews.text: ほとんど色のつかないほんのりピーチなヌーディカラーのグロスです。元々グロス類が大好きなので、この製品もツヤ感が綺麗で気に入っています。若干のプランプ効果かややピリピリする感じがある気がします。企画セットのペンシルがとても可愛くてこれ目的で買っても良いくらいだと思います！
reviews.zh: 呢支係幾乎冇乜顏色嘅淡淡桃色裸調唇彩。本來就好鍾意唇彩呢類產品，所以呢支嘅光澤感好靚我都好滿意。感覺有少少豐唇效果或者輕微刺刺地。套裝入面支唇筆真係好可愛，為咗支筆而買都抵！

reviews.shade: [SET] 04 Nudy Cocoa (+Lip Pencil Mini No.25 Beige Ring Lip Lighter)
reviews.text: I really like this gloss, the shade 04 is so pretty. You do have to put the applicator into the gloss a few times to get a good amount of product but other than that I like it. Would purchase again!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢支唇彩，04 號色真係好靚。要沾幾次唇彩先拎到足夠嘅量，但除此之外我都幾滿意。會再回購！

reviews.shade: [SET] 01 Pink Blanc (+Lip Pencil Mini No.24 Pink Ring Lip Lighter)
reviews.text: Gives a nice, buildable shine that doesn't feel too heavy. I prefer the Heart Percent Dote on Mood Glowy Tint
reviews.zh: 光澤感好靚而且可以層疊，唔會覺得太厚重。我比較鍾意 Heart Percent Dote on Mood Glowy Tint。

reviews.text: The design is so cute. The formula isn’t too sticky, but it doesn’t last very long, so I usually pair it with another tint.
reviews.zh: 設計好得意。質地唔算太黏笠，但就唔算好持久，所以我通常會配搭另一支唇釉一齊用。

reviews.shade: [SET] 04 Nudy Cocoa (+Lip Pencil Mini No.25 Beige Ring Lip Lighter)
reviews.text: This gloss provides a smooth, glossy finish with buildable color that layers comfortably on the lips. The formula feels moisturizing and creates a reflective shine without feeling overly heavy
reviews.zh: 呢支唇彩有順滑有光澤嘅妝效，顏色可以層疊，喺嘴唇上疊得好舒服。質地感覺保濕，做出反光感嘅光澤但又唔會太厚重。

reviews.shade: [SET] 01 Pink Blanc (+Lip Pencil Mini No.24 Pink Ring Lip Lighter)
reviews.text: A very sheer neutral pink peach. I genuinely like this shade. Not sure if I’ll repurchase, but I’m happy with it
reviews.zh: 好通透嘅中性粉桃色。我真心鍾意呢個色號。雖然唔確定會唔會回購，但我對佢好滿意。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
